_note: Five room types, 64 rooms + 12 villas = 76 keys. Photo paths are local; sources and credits are tracked in apps/web/public/images/CREDITS.md.

room_types.name: Plantation Room
room_types.summary: A calm room under the silver oaks, with a sit-out over the coffee rows.
room_types.description: Wooden floors, a planter's chair on the sit-out and a rain shower. You wake to bulbuls and the smell of drying coffee in season.
amenities: Tea and coffee tray with estate coffee

photos.alt: Plantation Room with a king bed and a wooden sit-out facing coffee rows
Rain shower in a stone-finished bathroom
Planter's chair on the sit-out at dawn

room_types.name: Estate View Room
room_types.summary: Floor-to-ceiling glass over the valley, where the mist rolls in by four.
room_types.description: Upper-floor rooms with a long window seat, a deep tub and a balcony facing the Mullayanagiri ridge.
amenities: Tea and coffee tray with estate coffee

photos.alt: Estate View Room with a window seat looking over a misty valley
Balcony with two chairs facing hills

room_types.name: Heritage Planter's Suite
room_types.summary: Suites in the restored 1920s planter's bungalow, with a separate sitting room.
room_types.description: High ceilings, Mangalore-tile roofs, a fireplace sitting room and a verandah onto the old garden.

photos.alt: Heritage suite sitting room with a fireplace and wooden beams
Verandah of an old planter's bungalow

room_types.name: Coffee Villa
room_types.summary: A standalone villa in the coffee, with a garden, outdoor shower and space for a family.
room_types.description: Each villa sits on its own path through the plantation. It has a living room with a day bed, an outdoor shower and a garden deck. Pets are welcome.

photos.alt: Standalone villa with a sloping tiled roof among coffee plants
Villa living room with a day bed and garden doors

room_types.name: Pool Villa
room_types.summary: Two bedrooms and a heated plunge pool on the edge of the valley.
room_types.description: Our most private stay: a heated infinity plunge pool, two bedrooms, a pavilion for dining in and a dedicated host.

photos.alt: Infinity plunge pool overlooking misty hills
Open dining pavilion beside a villa pool at dusk
